shots.description: A farmer and his brown dog walk side-by-side through a golden wheat field, sun low on the horizon
The farmer smiles gently as the dog trots beside him, wheat stalks brushing their legs

scenes.setting: edge of the wheat field, under a large oak tree

shots.description: The farmer and dog approach a large oak tree at the field's edge, casting long shadows
The farmer sits against the tree trunk, petting the dog who rests his head on the farmer's lap, both looking towards the sunset
